annotations.text:
Design emails here in the website's real fonts + tokens.
Approved artboards get baked into Klaviyo as image-first emails — only the order ticket stays dynamic.
[COUPON] = placeholder, needs a real code.

One row per Klaviyo flow. The note at the left of each row names the flow and how it sends.

ABANDONED CART REMINDER
Standard (Email & SMS) · flow U62Fdc

Status: DRAFT — not sending yet.
Trigger: checkout started.
Sends at +4h → +24h → +44h.

SMS-consented profiles get the SMS instead of email 1, then rejoin for 2 and 3.

TO WIRE UP: the flow's three messages still point at the old "YM - …" templates, not the "YM Theme - Abandoned Cart #1–3" ones these artboards bake into. Repoint them in the flow editor.

Email 3's send filter uses a hardcoded date (before 2026-06-04) — worth a second look.

NO ARTBOARDS YET
These flows exist in Klaviyo and already build from the shared components, but have not been designed here:

· Welcome Series — 3 emails
· Browse Abandonment — 2 emails
· Review Request + Reminder
· Order Confirmation
· Shipping Confirmation

Each becomes its own row when designed. Only "Review request" is live; every other flow is a draft.
